The speech is prepared but delivered live, so it mixes fluent presentation with genuine spontaneity, applause and audience noise. Runs on this corpus are capped at 2,000 clips, drawn with a pinned seed so every fighter is scored on the same ones; a split smaller than the cap is scored in full.
